purpose: Describe the remaining result of an intentional action.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
The documents have been placed on the desk.
The window has been left open.
The reservation has already been made.
Observe a state, recognize preparation, or prepare in advance
restrictions: Focus is on a resulting state, often suggesting preparation by someone.
mistake: Do not confuse intentional result てある with an ongoing action.
